evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Implement measures and processes to improve data quality, accuracy, coverage, lineage, access and retention across dozens of source production databases.
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Governance, quality control, code review, validation and "fostering trust in our data" dominate; "move at a fast pace" is company copy, so rigour.
evidence.domain_risk: ensure trustworthy data is available for all downstream data users
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: A talent marketplace's internal data with no regulatory or financial-reporting language, so moderate.
evidence.collaboration_width: Business Analysts; Data Engineers; Data Scientists
evidence.data_team_maturity: This role sits within the Business Analytics Center of Excellence
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: A Center of Excellence, a production warehouse with code review and separate Business Analysts, Data Engineers and Data Scientists implies a specialised, established function.
evidence.jd_authorship: Establish the grain, surface the edge cases, write down the business rules
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Specific modelling practice (grain, edge cases, data dictionary lineage, agent playbooks) shows someone who does the work wrote it.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: Work closely with Business Analysts, Data Engineers, Data Scientists, and business process owners
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The role is product owner of the warehouse for analysts, engineers and scientists, so the audience is the data function.
evidence.autonomy_level: You will be the product owner for our data warehouse
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: Owning the transformation layer and data dictionary, being product owner and bringing "your own point of view" are strategic.
evidence.ai_role: This documentation is consumed by AI agents as well as humans, and is an integral part of the semantic layer.
evidence.ai_role_explanation: The candidate must use agentic coding tools daily and also builds documentation and a semantic layer that AI agents consume; with both signals the tie-breaker gives ai_enabler.
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Quality control, data validation and tests are the candidate's responsibility, with process discipline for verifying output.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: Trust, incidents and verifying LLM-generated code are concerns, but there is no compliance or audit register, so moderate.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: Own and maintain the transformation layer.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: Own, maintain and improve on an existing warehouse with new sources added, so mixed.
